title: Parked shelf: drag pills to reorder them, and Alt+U keeps you in the shelf until Alt+U again
summary: Parked pills can be dragged into any order (kept for the app session), and Alt+U now toggles the shelf: Enter restores a terminal and keeps the cursor in the shelf, in every view, zoomed or not.
lessons_learned: Keyboard-focus stories must be tested in all four views (project, project zoomed, eagle, eagle zoomed): eagle zoom has its own zoom-focus effect that steals focus, and a zoomed-away pane is invisible and cannot take focus; round 1 missed both.
